subject: Align on Exec Bridge + Technical Deep Dive — next steps
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Shah <pshah@somnitech.com>, Anil Gupta <anil.gupta@somnitech.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Align on Exec Bridge + Technical Deep Dive — next steps

Hi Priyanka / Anil,

Thanks again for the time today — really useful discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 
- Key goals you shared: shorten inference latency for customer-facing assistants, reduce per-token cost on batch jobs, and have an audit trail for model decisions. 
- Success criteria: <10% user-facing latency regression vs current baseline, 30% token-cost reduction on nightly batch, and SOC2-aligned audit logs.

To keep momentum, can we schedule two back-to-back sessions: (A) a 30-minute "exec bridge" with Priyanka + your CTO (to align commercial and architecture priorities), and (B) a 60-minute technical deep dive with our lead SE (Vivek) to walk through architecture, integration patterns, and a small POC plan. My ask: include whoever will own the procurement/architecture sign-off on your side (CTO/VP Eng).

Suggested windows next week (PST):
- Tue 11 Aug, 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–16:00
- Wed 12 Aug, 13:30–16:00

If none of those work, share 2 windows that fit your CTO's calendar and we'll adapt. I attached post-call notes and a short exec-brief that summarizes the value/opportunity. Vivek will prepare a ~20-min architecture narrative + demo for the deep dive.

Thanks — Tessa

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf, exec-brief.pdf

From: Priyanka Shah <pshah@somnitech.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 18:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Align on Exec Bridge + Technical Deep Dive — next steps

Thanks Tessa — great recap. Anil and I appreciated the call. A couple quick items: 
- Our CTO (Ravi Menon) can join, but his availability is limited next week — he has a full travel schedule. Best slot for him is Wed 12 Aug afternoon (US Pacific).
- For the exec bridge, Ravi prefers a focused 20–25 minute sync (high-level value, timeline, and contractual expectations). He doesn't need the full technical deck.

Proposed approach:
1) Wed 12 Aug, 14:00–14:25 PT — Exec bridge (Ravi + Priyanka + Tessa + brief commercial lead).
2) Wed 12 Aug, 15:00–16:00 PT — Technical deep dive with Vivek and engineering teammates.

Also — can you share a one-page executive summary (no more than one side) that I can send to Ravi? He asked for something succinct to review before the call.

If you want Marcus (commercial) on the exec call, include him; otherwise we can keep it to product/CTO.

—Priyanka

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 19:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Align on Exec Bridge + Technical Deep Dive — next steps

Marcus / Vivek — forwarding Priyanka's availability. Ravi (CTO) is best Wed 12 Aug afternoon; they suggested:
- 14:00–14:25 PT (exec bridge)
- 15:00–16:00 PT (tech deep dive)

Marcus: could you join the exec bridge? Priyanka said "include Marcus if you want" — I think getting the commercial head in the room will accelerate decisioning. Also, we may want to prepare a small trial offer (2–4 weeks of reserved capacity credits) to unblock evaluation — can you confirm if there's flexibility on that and who needs to approve?
Vivek: can you own the tech deep dive? Focus areas: integration pattern for streaming assistants, KV cache behavior, and cost tradeoffs with batching/quantization. Vivek — if you can share a 1-page architecture summary and a Zoom link, I'll send the invite out.
Thanks — Tessa

(Attachment: redwood-arch-one-pager.pdf)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Align on Exec Bridge + Technical Deep Dive — next steps

- 1-page architecture summary (attached)
- 20–25 minute technical narrative + demo plan (we'll hit streaming latency, KV cache, batching, and a small quantization comparison)
- a minimal integration checklist and sample request/response patterns

Proposed Zoom link and calendar slots (I'll block tentatively until invite is sent):
- Wed 12 Aug 14:00–14:25 PT (Exec bridge — I'll join briefly for Qs)
- Wed 12 Aug 15:00–16:00 PT (Tech deep dive)
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/123456789 (passcode: RWD123)

Attaching the architecture one-pager now.
—Vivek
